title: The Hidden Cost of Feeling Unsafe
summary: Explore the hidden costs of physical security and learn how safer, more efficient screening can support business performance.
body_markdown:
***The Business Impact Leaders Can’t Afford to Ignore***


The impact of physical security extends far beyond preventing incidents. When employees, visitors, patients, students, and guests feel unsafe, or when outdated screening processes create unnecessary friction, the effects can reach workforce retention, operational efficiency, stakeholder trust, and financial performance.


This whitepaper explores how organizations can take a more comprehensive approach to safety, balancing effective threat detection with the welcoming, efficient experience people expect. It also provides a practical framework and self-assessment to help leaders evaluate their current security environment and identify opportunities for improvement.


#### Download the whitepaper to learn how to:


- Understand the connection between safety, workforce stability, operations, and organizational performance
- Identify hidden costs associated with entry bottlenecks and high-friction security processes
- Evaluate your organization across People, Operations, Trust, and Growth
- Assess your current security and operational readiness and identify practical next steps
